hooks.name: ui-a11y-smoke
hooks.description: Change in a UI component, app screen or devtools: run the Playwright axe smoke tests (landing, Spellbook, Settings).

hooks.name: requirements-changed
hooks.description: A spec's requirements.md changed: remind the agent to re-run Analyze Requirements and keep property test citations in sync.

action.prompt: A requirements.md just changed. Before designing or coding: (1) run Analyze Requirements on this spec and list contradictions or gaps it finds, (2) check that every tests/properties/P*.prop.test.ts describe() title still cites requirement ids that exist, (3) record what changed and why in docs/kiro-journal.md under 'Spec changes'.

hooks.name: new-action-parity
hooks.description: An app definition changed: every action needs Spellbook examples in en/hi/ta and a keyboard path (menuLabel or a panel button).

action.prompt: An app's defineApp file changed. For every action in it, check: examples exist for en, hi and ta; the action is reachable without voice (menuLabel for object actions, or a button in main.tsx for others); destructive actions that can affect several objects set destructive: true. Run `node scripts/vitest.mjs run tests/unit/apps.test.ts` and fix anything that fails. Then run `npm run app-size` and report the line count.

hooks.name: turn-end-gate
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn: determinism lint, app-size budget, typecheck and unit tests (the pre-push gate).

action.command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
